rotate.descValue: Creates a new provider-backed version. Consumers pinned to latest pick up the new value on the next run.
rotate.descReference: Creates a new Paperclip metadata version that points at an existing provider secret. Paperclip does not write a new provider value.
rotate.descExternalValue: Writes a new version of the referenced provider secret. The new value becomes current for every consumer of that secret, in and outside Paperclip.
rotate.deploymentNote: Rotating with the deployment default preserves current fallback behavior.
rotate.referenceNote: Rotate the actual value in the provider before changing this Paperclip reference.
